_comment: UPE Marketing KPI targets — read by the daily council. Edit to retune goals.

north_star.followers_note: North-star organic followers (IL + EU decision-makers at companies that run events needing a production company / local supplier). Honest path is multi-year; the council optimizes the leading indicators below, not vanity follower count.

primary_kpi.leads_definition: Real NEW inbound leads from NEW potential clients for substantial events/conferences (not existing clients, not vendors).
primary_kpi.leads_source: WIRED via leads_source.py (Salesforce client-credentials); Opportunity CreatedDate LAST_N_DAYS.

aeo_targets._comment: Targets for the weekly AEO/GEO loop. per_dimension_min = score below which a dimension is 'weak' and generates briefs.

organic_targets._note: weekly_clicks_min is compared against clicks_7d from the astro snapshot (true 7-day window since 05.09.2026; before that the 28-day total was labelled weekly). top3 = queries at position <= 3.5 with >= 10 impressions in 28 days.

context_metrics._comment: Shown for visibility, NOT scored. Engagement/impressions no longer drag the headline.

_digital_lead_sources_note: Must mirror the ACTUAL Salesforce LeadSource picklist (Facebook/Instagram/Google Ads/Linkedin) plus the values api/lead.js writes (Google Organic, Bing Organic, Organic Search). Before 05.09.2026 the list lacked Facebook/Instagram/Google Ads, so those leads counted as non-digital.
